summary.text: The front matter of the Chinese edition of WHO's 2012 recommendations on optimising health worker roles for maternal and newborn health through task shifting, with copyright and disclaimer text. It includes a table defining health worker cadres, such as advanced-level and mid-level associate clinicians, auxiliary nurses, auxiliary midwives and lay health workers, with their training and alternative titles. It then summarises the guideline methods, including GRADE evidence profiles and the DECIDE framework. The block ends by introducing the recommendation categories used by the guideline panel.

summary.text: Defines the "recommended" category as meaning the intervention should be implemented.

blocks.title: “建议，需进行有针对性的监测和评估”
blocks.target: ../sections/sec-001-2-建议需进行有针对性的监测和评估.md
blocks.content:
该分级表明对该干预措施的有效性和可接受性存在
不确定性，特别是在一些特殊环境和条件下。可以考
虑实施划入本类别的干预措施（包括大规模实施），
前提是对其进行有针对性的监测和评估。必须特别注
意尚存在关切（如风险或危害）或者不存在相关信息
或信息很少的具体问题。可以从广泛来源获得监测和
评估信息，包括定期数据和调查数据。指南专家组还
努力厘清了应监测干预措施的哪些方面，并说明了相
关指标。

summary.text: Defines the category "recommended with targeted monitoring and evaluation", used where there is uncertainty about effectiveness or acceptability in some settings and implementation should be monitored with suitable indicators.

blocks.title: “仅在缜密研究的情况下建议”
blocks.target: ../sections/sec-002-3-仅在缜密研究的情况下建议.md
blocks.content:
该分级表明对某项干预措施存在重要不确定性。在
这种情况下，仍可进行大规模实施，但前提是以研究
形式进行，研究目的是处理与该干预措施的有效性及
其可接受性和可行性有关的未决问题和不确定性。为
评估干预措施的有效性，该研究应至少将接触某种方
案的人群与未接触者进行对比，并应包括基线评估。
相互比较的人群应尽可能类似，以便确保对干预措施
的效果而非其它因素进行评估。随机试验是实现这一
目的的最有效方式，但如不可能进行随机试验，应考
虑开展断续时间序列分析或前后对照研究。如果没有
对照组或基线评估，相关研究很可能会出现偏差，不
能反映干预措施的真实效果。
  如果未决问题或不确定性与干预措施的可接受性或
可行性有关，相关研究应包括进行定性研究和定量设
计以探讨这些问题，例如调查。

summary.text: Defines the category "recommended only in the context of rigorous research", used where there is important uncertainty. It explains that implementation should take the form of research with comparison groups and baseline measures, ideally randomised trials, plus qualitative work where acceptability or feasibility is in doubt.

summary.text: Defines the "not recommended" category and states that the guideline panel, convened by WHO in Geneva in April and June 2012, made 119 recommendations across eight types of health worker. It notes questions the panel excluded, such as self-administered misoprostol, and the removal of antiretroviral recommendations to align with newer WHO HIV guidance. It stresses the need for national dialogue on implementation and lists recommended tasks by cadre, from health promotion by lay health workers to caesarean section by advanced-level associate clinicians.
